newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARIAN SHARES SEEN EASING FURTHER AHEAD OF FOMC.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARIAN SHARES SEEN EASING FURTHER AHEAD OF FOMC.

text.p: Hungarian share prices are seen giving up more on Wednesday after a 0.6 percent fall on Tuesday, weighed on by slight fears ahead of the FOMC meeting, traders said.
"There's some uncertainty by foreigners because of the Fed meeting," said Peter Nagy of Postabank Securities. "The other factor weighing on is a natural profit-taking after strong rises."
The trader said he expected decline on the market despite the fact that the dollar's strength would justify price rises.
In its weekly market report, Raiffeisen Securities said it expected sideways trend for the week.
"After a significant increase in the past few weeks we expect trendless trading in the coming days," Raiffeisen said.
On Tuesday the BUX index finished at 6,753.95 points, down 41.05.
